definitions.explanation: A compound referring to both males and females collectively.

examples.japanese: {男女|だんじょ}⟦{平等|びょうどう}→平等：03590_byoudou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
{男女|だんじょ}⟦{合|あ}わせて→合わせる：01872_awaseru⟧⟦{百|ひゃく}→百：00780_hyaku⟧⟦{人|にん}→〜人：00658_nin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{参加|さんか}→参加：02498_sanka⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A total of one hundred people, both men and women, participated.

examples.japanese: {男女|だんじょ}⟦{別|べつ}→別：01216_betsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦トイレ→トイレ：00818_toire⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There are separate toilets for men and women.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{男女|だんじょ}⟦{共学|きょうがく}→共学：15412_kyougaku⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。

{男女|だんじょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{問|と}わず→問う：02299_tou⟧、⟦{誰|だれ}→誰：00534_dare⟧⟦でも→でも：00925_demo⟧⟦{参加|さんか}→参加：02498_sanka⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧⟦イベント→イベント：09594_ibento⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{来月|らいげつ}→来月：00744_raigetsu⟧⟦{開|ひら}かれる→開く：01979_hiraku⟧。
examples.english: An event that anyone can participate in, regardless of gender, will be held next month.

notes:
COMPOUND: {男|だん} (male) + {女|じょ} (female)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {男女|だんじょ}⟦{平等|びょうどう}→平等：03590_byoudou⟧ (gender equality)
- {男女|だんじょ}⟦{差別|さべつ}→差別：01633_sabetsu⟧ (gender discrimination)
- {男女|だんじょ}⟦{共同|きょうどう}→共同：02591_kyoudou⟧⟦{参画|さんかく}→参画：12079_sankaku⟧ (gender equality participation)
- {男女|だんじょ}⟦{別|べつ}→別：01216_betsu⟧ (separated by gender)
- {男女|だんじょ}⟦{混合|こんごう}→混合：04154_kongou⟧ (mixed gender, co-ed)

NOTE: When referring to 'male and female' in contexts like animals, ⟦{雄|おす}→雄：10732_osu⟧ (male) and ⟦{雌|めす}→雌：11243_mesu⟧ (female) are used instead.
